title: [review] adaptation_vectors.rs: Silent test skip masks missing vectors f
description: When the vectors file is missing, the test prints to stderr and returns Ok, passing silently. In CI this hides the fact that critical P0 security vectors were never validated. Consider using #[ignore] if optional, or cfg(feature) gating, or panicking with a clearer message when running in CI (e.g., check CARGO_CFG_TARGET_OS or CI env var).
close_reason: Fixed silent skip on missing vectors by panicking when CI env var is set. Both test_schc_adaptation_vectors and test_schc_adaptation_coverage now fail loudly in CI if vectors file is missing, while still allowing local dev to skip gracefully.
